description: This file defines a PHP class named Fixer within the OpenCart admin extension for currency management. The class handles currency exchange rate updates via the Fixer API, including functions to display the configuration form, save settings, and fetch currency rates from the API.

classes.name: Fixer
classes.description: This class manages the currency exchange rates via Fixer API and provides the admin interface for configuring the currency settings within the OpenCart extension.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Displays the currency configuration page, including loading language, setting breadcrumbs, and passing data to the view.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Handles the saving of currency fixer API settings, updates currency exchange rates based on API response, and invalidates the currency cache.

methods.name: currency
methods.description: Fetches currency rates from the Fixer API and updates currency values in the system, with optional default currency parameter.
